senses.definition: vb. interpret (a dream) (𝔗 id., Syriac ܦܫܰܪ, perhaps EgyptianAramaic פשר Lzb355 SAC100 (Arabic فسّر loan-word, v. Frä263); Assyrian pašâru);—
Inf. לְמִפְשַׁר Dn 5:16, acc. cogn. פִּשְׁרִין.
Pt. act. מְפַשַּׁר Dn 5:12, acc. חֶלְמִין.
